name: Nuvema Area
description: The green southern start of Unova around Nuvema Town and Accumula, spanning the first routes, the Dreamyard, and Striaton City.

name: Nacrene Area
description: The wooded west around Nacrene City, home to the sprawling Pinwheel Forest and the dark Wellspring Cave.

name: Castelia Area
description: The bustling metropolis of Castelia City and the parched Desert Resort that stretches beyond Route 4.

name: Nimbasa Area
description: The neon amusement city of Nimbasa, Route 5, and the long Driftveil Drawbridge spanning the bay.

name: Driftveil Area
description: The rugged market port of Driftveil, the electric Chargestone Cave, and the frozen Cold Storage.

name: Mistralton Area
description: The windswept runway town of Mistralton, Route 7, the towering Celestial Tower, and Twist Mountain.

name: Icirrus Area
description: The snowbound north around Icirrus City, the boggy Moor of Icirrus, and the ancient Dragonspiral Tower.

name: Opelucid Area
description: The dragon-tamers' city of Opelucid, the eastern routes, and the winding climb of Victory Road.
